Android lets an app read other apps’ logs only if the app holds READ_LOGS, which only adb can give. Run once on a computer:\nadb shell pm grant %1$s android.permission.READ_LOGS\nthen start this app again.

Android asks only while this screen is open. Press the button, then tap “Allow one-time access”. If you tapped “Don’t allow”, or the question timed out, Android keeps that answer for a minute, so the button works again in about 75 seconds.
